title: Certification Manager
description:
Job Opening: Certification Officer / Manager

**Location:**
Kottayam

**Salary:**
Up to ₹60,000 per month, depending on experience

**Additional Benefit:**
Company car provided for site visits

About the Role

We are looking for a qualified and experienced
**FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) Certification Officer / Manager**
to lead the implementation of FSC certification for our smallholder farmers and company operations.

The primary objective of this role is to obtain
**Forest Management (FM) certification for smallholder farmers and Chain of Custody (CoC) certification for the company**
. The successful candidate will work closely with farmers, internal teams, and certification bodies to ensure compliance with FSC standards and facilitate a smooth certification and audit process.

This is a hands-on role that requires fieldwork, site mapping, documentation, stakeholder engagement, and a strong understanding of FSC certification requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* **FSC Certification:**
  Lead and coordinate the process of obtaining Forest Management (FM) certification for smallholder farmers and Chain of Custody (CoC) certification for the company.
* **Farmer Engagement:**
  Serve as the primary point of contact for farmers interested in participating in the FSC certification programme, including onboarding, coordination, and ongoing support.
* **Forest Mapping:**
  Conduct and coordinate mapping of all relevant farmer plots and forest sites, ensuring accurate geographical records and maps are available for certification and audit purposes.
* **Documentation and Compliance:**
  Prepare, organise, and maintain all required documentation, records, procedures, and compliance systems in accordance with applicable FSC standards.
* **Audit Coordination:**
  Liaise with FSC-accredited certification bodies, coordinate audits and site assessments, and ensure that any identified non-conformities are addressed promptly.
* **Training and Capacity Building:**
  Provide training and guidance to farmers, field staff, and other stakeholders on FSC requirements, responsible forest management, and relevant compliance procedures.
* **Chain of Custody Implementation:**
  Establish and maintain the necessary systems, records, and procedures to support the company's CoC certification.
* **Field Visits:**
  Regularly travel to farmer plots and operational sites to verify information, monitor compliance, collect data, and support certification implementation.
* **Progress Monitoring:**
  Track certification milestones, maintain farmer and site databases, and provide regular updates on implementation progress.

Candidate Requirements

* A
  **BSc in Forestry**
  or a related qualification is preferred.
* Previous experience in FSC certification, forest management certification, sustainability auditing, or certification consultancy is highly desirable.
* Experience working as an FSC auditor, supporting certification audits, or implementing FSC certification programmes will be a strong advantage.
* Practical knowledge of FSC Forest Management (FM) and Chain of Custody (CoC) standards and certification procedures.
* Experience in forest or farm mapping, GPS-based data collection, GIS tools, or geospatial mapping.
* Ability to prepare and manage technical documentation, audit records, compliance reports, and site-level data.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, particularly when working with farmers and field teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly between sites.
* A
  **valid driving licence**
  is essential, as the role involves frequent field visits.

What We Offer

* Salary of up to
  **₹60,000 per month**
  , depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
* Company car provided for site visits.
* An opportunity to lead the development and implementation of an FSC certification programme from the ground up.
* A field-oriented role with the opportunity to work directly with smallholder farmers and contribute to responsible forest management and sustainable supply chains.

title: Australian Migration (GSM) Documentation Specialist
description:
**Job description:**

The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Setting the Quality Standard

–Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved

–Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward

–Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it

–Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure

2. Checking Files Before Submission

–Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority

–Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements

–Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign-off

3. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules

–Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines

–Updates the team quickly whenever rules change

–Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements

4. Improving How Things Work

–Creates clear step-by-step processes for the team to follow

–Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly

–Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening

5. Reducing Errors and Rejections

–Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from

–Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened

–Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again

–Works toward getting files right the first time, every time

6. Reporting to Leadership

–Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing

–Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends

–Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly

7. Working With Other Teams

–Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff

–Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business

–Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk

8. Training the Team

–Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills

–Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes

–Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager

9. Protecting Client Information

–Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private

–Follows all legal and company rules around data protection

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

–Has a relevant degree

–Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services

–Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years

–Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires

–Has used case management or CRM systems before

–Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus

Work Location: In person

title: Marine
description:
**Company Description**
S & O Maritime Services is an engineering, project management, and consultancy company specializing in the marine and oil & gas industries. Founded by a team of passionate and experienced professionals, the company operates branches in the United Arab Emirates and India and supports clients across marine and offshore sectors. S & O Maritime Services delivers end-to-end solutions, including engineering, technical support, project management, interface engineering, and product sourcing. The team’s diverse expertise covers Naval Architecture, Structural, Marine, Electrical Engineering, Project Management, and Surveying, enabling comprehensive, solution-oriented support. By combining advanced technology with deep industry knowledge, the company develops practical and innovative answers to complex marine and oilfield challenges.
  
**Role Description**
The Marine Equipment and Technical Publications Intern will support the engineering and consultancy teams with documentation and information management related to marine equipment and systems. This internship role is on-site and located in Aluva. Day-to-day tasks may include assisting in preparing technical manuals, equipment specifications, operation and maintenance procedures, and project reports for marine and oil & gas projects. The intern will help organize and update technical datasets, drawings, and reference materials, ensuring accuracy and consistency across publications. This role also involves collaborating with engineers and project managers to gather technical inputs, performing basic research on marine standards and regulations, and contributing to layout, formatting, and quality checks of technical documents.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to understand and document technical information related to marine equipment, systems, and engineering processes.
* Strong written communication skills for drafting, editing, and organizing technical reports, manuals, and other publications.
* Basic familiarity with engineering or marine-related disciplines (such as Naval Architecture, Mechanical, Marine, or Electrical Engineering) through academic coursework or projects.
* Proficiency with standard office and documentation tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation software), and willingness to learn specialized technical documentation tools as needed.
* Attention to detail, ability to follow structured procedures, and commitment to maintaining accurate and consistent technical records.
* Effective collaboration skills, including the ability to work with multidisciplinary teams and seek clarification from subject matter experts.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a relevant diploma or degree in engineering, marine technology, or a related field; prior exposure to the marine or oil & gas industry is an advantage.
* Interest in developing a career in technical documentation, marine equipment support, or engineering services within the marine and offshore sectors.

title: Associate/Intern
